auth_type_selection.title: Choose Connection Mode
auth_type_selection.description:
Select which connections you want to set up. You connect locally over your network to the HCU.

> Recommended: Run both users in parallel (DualBridge).

data.use_app_user: App User — Full feature support (no developer mode needed). Requires pressing the system button on the HCU.

global_settings.title: Global settings
global_settings.description: Configure global settings and filters for device import.

data_description.disable_unconfigured_channels: Disables channels that are not configured in the Homematic IP app or are not assigned to a room. These channels will not be created in Home Assistant.
data_description.auto_reload_on_device_change: When enabled, the integration automatically reloads when a device is removed from the HCU, or when a device's name, channel role, or switch visualization changes. The reload takes about 1–2 seconds, during which all entities will briefly show as unavailable. Disable this option if you want to prevent automatic reloads and manage device changes manually (e.g. by restarting Home Assistant).
data_description.comfort_temperature: Set the comfort temperature used for Party Mode here.
data_description.selected_oems: Choose which manufacturers should be imported into Home Assistant.
data_description.disabled_groups: Choose which groups should be hidden. You can find the group names in the additional attributes of each entity.

developer_settings.title: Developer Mode
developer_settings.description: These settings are intended for troubleshooting and development. They can generate large amounts of log output — disable them again when no longer needed.

data_description.advanced_debugging: Enable to log the complete raw data of HMIP_SYSTEM_EVENT events. Disable this again when you no longer need it.
data_description.advanced_attributes: Enable to show additional developer attributes per entity.

vacation.title: Set Vacation Mode
vacation.description: Activate the time-based vacation mode. This will set all heating groups to the specified temperature until the end time. To deactivate, use the 'hcu_integration.deactivate_absence_mode' service.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the HCU.
error.api_error: An API error occurred while trying to set vacation mode.
error.invalid_data: Invalid date/time format or temperature value. Please check your input.

setup_failed.title: Cannot connect to Homematic IP HCU ({host})

confirm.title: Retry connection
confirm.description:
The integration failed to start for the HCU at **{host}**.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Connection mode** | {auth_mode} |
| **Reason** | {reason} |

Check that the HCU is powered on and reachable, then click **Submit** to reload the integration. If the problem persists, go to **Settings → Integrations → Homematic IP HCU → Reconfigure**.

confirm.title: Update PIN
confirm.description: The authorization PIN for **{device_name}** failed. The device-specific PIN takes priority: open the device settings for {device_name} in Home Assistant and update the PIN there. Alternatively, you can update the global PIN under Settings → Integrations → Homematic IP HCU → Configure → Lock PIN. After updating, reload the integration.

confirm.title: Fix access authorization
confirm.description:
The integration is not authorized to control device **{device_name}** channel **{channel_index}**.

To fix this:
1. Open the **Homematic IP** app
2. Go to → **More** → **Access authorisations**
3. Add **'Home Assistant Integration'** to the authorisation profile
4. Ensure a PIN is set
5. Click **Submit** below, then reload the integration.

play_sound.name: Play Sound
play_sound.description: Plays a sound file on a compatible device (e.g., HmIP-MP3P doorbell, alarm sirens).

sound_file.name: Sound File
sound_file.description: The name of the sound file to play (e.g., 'SOUND_01', 'ALARM_01').

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: The volume level for the sound, from 0.0 to 1.0.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The duration in seconds for which the sound should play.

set_rule_state.name: Set Rule State
set_rule_state.description: Enables or disables a simple automation rule within the HCU.

rule_id.name: Rule ID
rule_id.description: The unique identifier of the rule to be controlled.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable the rule.

set_display_content.name: Set Display Content
set_display_content.description: Sets the text and icon on an e-paper display of a compatible device (e.g., HmIP-WRCD).

line_1.name: Line 1
line_1.description: The text to display on the first line.

line_2.name: Line 2
line_2.description: The text to display on the second line.

line_3.name: Line 3
line_3.description: The text to display on the third line.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: The name of the icon to display (e.g., 'ICON_SUN', 'ICON_MOON'). See API docs for options.

activate_vacation_mode.name: Activate Vacation Mode
activate_vacation_mode.description: Activates the system-wide vacation mode for all heating groups until a specified time.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The target temperature for the vacation period.

end_time.name: End Time
end_time.description: The date and time when the vacation mode should end. Format: 'YYYY_MM_DD HH:MM' or any string parsable by Home Assistant.

activate_eco_mode.name: Activate Eco Mode (Permanent Absence)
activate_eco_mode.description: Activates the system-wide permanent absence (Eco) mode for all heating groups.

deactivate_absence_mode.name: Deactivate Absence Mode
deactivate_absence_mode.description: Deactivates any active absence mode (Vacation or Eco) and returns heating to its previous schedule.

activate_party_mode.name: Activate Party Mode
activate_party_mode.description: Activates the party mode for a specific heating group with a specific temperature.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The target temperature for the party mode.

end_time.name: End Time
end_time.description: The date and time when the party mode should end (e.g., '2025_12_24 23:00'). Format: 'YYYY_MM_DD HH:MM' or any string parsable by Home Assistant. If provided, takes precedence over duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The duration in seconds for the party mode. Only used if end_time is not specified.

switch_on_with_time.name: Turn on with time
switch_on_with_time.description: Turns a switch on for a specific duration

on_time.name: On time
on_time.description: The duration in seconds for which the switch should stay on. Range: 0,1 – 16383 s

set_cooling_mode.name: Set Cooling Mode
set_cooling_mode.description: Activates or deactivates the system-wide cooling mode for all heating groups.

cooling.name: Cooling
cooling.description: Set to true to activate cooling mode, false to deactivate it.

send_api_command.name: Send API Command
send_api_command.description: Send a raw API command to the HCU. Use with caution, as this provides direct access to the API and can cause unintended side effects if used incorrectly. See EQ3's API documentation for details.

body.name: Request Body
body.description: The request body as an object of key-value pairs.

create_user_message_request.name: Create a User Message
create_user_message_request.description: Creates a user message that is displayed in the Homematic IP app. See the eQ-3 API documentation for details.

message_category.name: Message Category
message_category.description: Select the category of the user message.

user_message_id.name: User Message ID
user_message_id.description: Enter a unique identifier for the user message.

title.name: Title
title.description: The title of the message. Can be a string or an object with language keys.

message.name: Message
message.description: The message can be a string or an object with language keys.

behavior_type.name: Behavior Type
behavior_type.description: Select how the message can be acknowledged or dismissed in the Homematic IP app.

delete_user_message_request.name: Delete a User Message
delete_user_message_request.description: Delete a previously created User Message from the Homematic IP app. See the EQ3 API documentation for details.

user_message_id.name: User Message ID
user_message_id.description: Use the User Message ID of the previously created User Message here.

state.frequency_lowon_longoff_highon_longoff: Low On/Long Off + High On/Long Off
